proposed_shared_four_digit_pin.actor_limit: A shared PIN proves group knowledge, not which individual entered it. It cannot by itself justify a named manager actor.
smallest_safe_contract: Main owns a backend-only enrollment endpoint; no PIN literal/digest belongs in web assets, URLs, logs or this evidence.
Retain server attempt limits, revocation, credential/device binding, token validation and independent role/employee permission checks.
If individual attribution remains required, associate a named browser/device only through an independently approved enrollment/identity step. Do not infer Jennifer or Annie from shared PIN knowledge.
Opaque persistent enrollment remains revocable and role-bound; shared PIN is not sent on every API call.
No credential issuance, security activation, Map-system change or production rollout is included.

viewer_source.backend: src/leadership-bootstrap.js:142-175 configured middleware only, no requireManager on these two routes

viewer_safe_contract: Keep aggregate operational count fields and explicitly public scheduled-event fields only.
Backend enforces response allowlists and public event audiences; frontend hiding does not establish privacy.
Exclude staff identities, roster/absence/PTO details, punch/payroll, device IDs, notes, submitted reports and internal ticket details.
No mutation routes, role elevation or authenticated manager API tokens are granted by the read-only link.
limits: Source inspection only. No production endpoint, genuine enrollment, auth activation or live privacy/runtime proof.
